name: Emily
source: A gentle, idealistic member of the Art Club who constantly seeks out perfect compositions in nature to escape the "grayness" of reality. She views the world through a deeply romantic and perfectionist lens, often feeling disappointed when reality fails to live up to her artistic standards. During the camp, this perfectionism is highlighted by her stubborn, emotional quest to find a real woodpecker, a goal tied to a tragic childhood memory of her late grandmother.
